(Previous report: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/229542#issuecomment-4281471434) > > While this issue persisted, I had no choice but to keep manually clicking "Disable protection for 30 seconds" to enable AI Mode on my desktop, and ended up going through the skit of having to use AI Mode on my smartphone with my desktop in front of me for over 4 months. > How long must I continue to experience this discomfort? > > I hope this report will be the last. comment.body:

- `iframe[title="Advertisement"]` was leftover side by side article content.
- `#div:has(> #membrana_video)` is ad video container.
- `.dailymotion-player-root` is positioned at the bottom.

comment.body:
Then `m.11st.co.kr###web2appPopup` will break the site on platforms without scriptlet support.
If on a real device scrolling is not blocked, you can use two element hiding rules

```
m.11st.co.kr###web2appPopup
m.11st.co.kr##.dim
```

If blocked - leave only cookie rule **or** 3 CSS rules. If for blocking/changing one element required at lease one CSS rule, all rules must be css (same type).

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://play.hbomax.com/video/watch-sport/7b2a25cc-b973-540f-aa45-1ee93d6644df/6bacd0aa-71c6-4626-a9a4-64c72b09ee2d](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fplay.hbomax.com%2Fvideo%2Fwatch-sport%2F7b2a25cc-b973-540f-aa45-1ee93d6644df%2F6bacd0aa-71c6-4626-a9a4-64c72b09ee2d) ### Comment > The following rule breaks rewinding on live streams: > > ``` > play.discoveryplus.com,play.hbomax.com#%#//scriptlet('xml-prune', 'xpath(//*[name()="MPD"]/@mediaPresentationDuration | //*[name()="Period"]/@start | //*[name()="Period"][not(.//*[name()="SegmentTimeline"] or .//*[name()="ContentProtection"])] | //*[name()="Period"][./*[name()="BaseURL"]][not(.//*[name()="ContentProtection"])])', '', '.mpd') > ``` > > Unlike VODs, live streams start with a `<Period start=` that is not 0, so stripping that breaks the scrub bar. > > Live streams don't really have "inserted" ads (they have natural ads as a part of the TV channel's live broadcast output), so might be worth checking for `MPD@type`: https://dashif.org/Guidelines-TimingModel/#timing-and-presentation-types (live streams have `dynamic` while VODs have `static`) ### Screenshots

In DevTools, open the Network tab and search for `1.m3u8` (if there is no `1.m3u8`, just search for `.m3u8` and choose any file except the one with `master` in its name) > 5. Click on that `.m3u8` request, go to the `Response` tab (screenshot below), copy the entire content, and share it > > Screenshot > > Anyway, I will add these rules. Before you ask 😏... I've cleared my browsing data: cookies, cache, site settings...

Note. Please add the option to change the language in the Mac version as well!
